## Flight Simulation

I am a virtual Seattle ARTCC controller, and a part of a wonderful community of virtual pilots and controllers on the [VATSIM](https://www.vatusa.net/){target="_blank"} network. Air traffic controlling is a fun and challenging hobby that keeps me on my toes, and I also fly (virtually).
